## Summary

I've successfully implemented the search feature for the list items endpoint. Here's what was done:

**Changes made:**

1. **Modified `/backend/app/api/routes/items.py`** — Added an optional `search` query parameter to the `read_items()` endpoint (line 19). The search filters items by title using case-insensitive substring matching via SQLModel's `ilike()` method. The filter is applied to both the count and items queries, maintaining existing permission logic (superusers see all items, regular users only see their own).

2. **Added tests** to `/backend/tests/api/routes/test_items.py`:
   - `test_read_items_with_search()` — Verifies search returns only matching items
   - `test_read_items_with_search_case_insensitive()` — Confirms case-insensitive matching works
   - `test_read_items_with_search_no_results()` — Confirms empty results when no matches found

**Verification:**

result: 14 passed (all existing tests + 3 new search tests)
